21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours: H axis = block row with most wall-10 corners, V axis = column with most; pieces ring 5, targets 11.
Selection shown as 0 centres; A5 cycles H -> V -> pieces (by min block) -> H; A1/A2 move H or selected piece, A3/A4 move V or piece; pieces blocked by edges/other pieces.
Every piece block mirrors across V, H and both into visible gray-4 blocks (skip off-board / piece-occupied cells).
Render ring piece>refl>target>wall>bg; centre target 11 > selected-axis 0 > selected piece 0 > refl 4 > 9; HUD col 63 gets one more 12 per effective action.
Stateless; unconfirmed hypothesis: axes pass freely under pieces/targets.
